entities.summary: Pál Reizer was a Romanian cleric, bishop of the Roman Catholic Diocese of Satu Mare. Born into an ethnic Hungarian family in Túrterebes (Turulung), Satu Mare County, he studied at the Roman Catholic Theological Institute of Alba Iulia and was ordained a priest in 1967 by Áron Márton. Under the communist regime, he was a chaplain at the parish in Sighetu Marmației, secretary at the Satu Mare diocese and a priest at a nunnery. In 1988, he was named parish priest at Sighetu Marmației. In 1990, after the fall of the regime, he was consecrated a bishop by Francesco Colasuonno, serving until his death.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Pál Reizer's consecration as bishop in 1990 marked a significant shift towards religious freedom in post-communist Romania, following the fall of the regime. His leadership helped rebuild the Catholic Church in the country.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: As a bishop in post-communist Romania, Pál Reizer played a key role in rebuilding the Roman Catholic Diocese of Satu Mare, serving as parish priest from 1988 until his death. His consecration in 1990 marked a significant moment in the diocese's recovery.
